==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Ranger
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Search for Zho in Kinya Province.

===Reward===
* 600 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Travel northwest from [[Sujun]] through the mountains until you reach [[Kinya Province]]. Once there, go a short distance northwest and you will find [[Zho]]


==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Sujun
:''"You have done well so far, but your training is far from complete. I am sorry to see you go, but I am afraid I must send you on to your next trainer. Look for [[Zho]] in [[Kinya Province]]. Her appearance and gruff demeanor is off-putting to some, but like all of us, she is special in her way. Good luck!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will look for Zho.
| decline = She sounds scary. I think I'll pass.
| ask = I know it is difficult to move on, but you really must go and find [[Zho]]. I have nothing left to teach you, and I am late for a peace rally.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zho
:''"You are late. We will begin your training promptly."''
